sections.description: SWP Dental Clinic is a clean, modern and professional WordPress theme built for dental clinics, dentists, orthodontists, dental surgeons, dental labs, oral care and teeth whitening studios, medical clinics, hospitals, doctors, physicians, surgeons, chiropractors, pediatricians, dermatologists, ophthalmologists, veterinary clinics, pharmacies, diagnostic labs, nursing homes, physiotherapy and rehab centres, wellness, spa and health care businesses of every size. Built on the Elementor page builder, it gives you full control to design and customise your website without touching a single line of code, and its fully responsive, mobile friendly and retina ready layout looks perfect on desktops, laptops, tablets and phones. The theme ships with pre designed sections for services, treatments, appointment booking, doctor and staff profiles, pricing tables, testimonials, FAQ, gallery, blog and contact, making it easy to showcase your practice and build trust with patients. The WordPress Customizer adds a custom logo, custom header, custom background and custom colors, while the theme also brings Google Fonts typography, boxed and full width layouts, a full width page template, footer widget areas, sticky posts, threaded comments, featured images, editor styles and wide block support in the block editor. Translation ready, cross browser compatible, SEO friendly, speed optimised and coded to WordPress standards with clean, secure, well documented code. It works smoothly with popular plugins including WooCommerce, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Yoast SEO, Jetpack, Polylang and booking plugins, so you can sell products or accept online appointments with ease. Whether you are launching a new practice, a corporate healthcare site, a small business page or upgrading an existing website, SWP Dental Clinic makes it simple, elegant and effective.
